name: – Motion for a resolution (as a whole)
title: MOTION FOR A RESOLUTION on election of the Commission
part_text:
This resolution does not change any law. It is an opinion from a political group stating that the November 2024 hearings of the proposed European Commissioners were too political. It says weak candidates were approved through deals between parties. It asks for stricter rules: public results of evaluation meetings, a two-thirds majority to elect the Commission and its President, and an end to pressure on countries over their nominees. It also rejects the Commission President's programme.

- No legal change; it asks for new hearing rules and a two-thirds voting threshold.
- It concerns Members of the European Parliament, Member States and proposed Commissioners.
- Parliament would need to revise its own rules; Member States would discuss wider reform.
